nodes.label: Audit log screen (EN)
nodes.rationale: File name says settings but the screen is the Audit log: every mutation, newest first, with time, actor (admin), action chip, subject and a details JSON column. Filter by action. Shows 636 entries. Entries cannot be edited or deleted. Visible actions include updateTenantSettings (staleAfterDays 30 then 31), upsertCustomFieldDefinition, deleteCustomFieldDefinition, setCiCustomFields, setAssetStage and setCiLifecycle.

nodes.label: Custom field definition
nodes.rationale: Tenant-defined field with a key, a type (select in the audit sample) and EN and AR labels. Definitions are upserted and deleted through audited actions. Custom fields are configuration rather than hardcoded CI attributes, which matches the no-hardcoding rule.

nodes.label: Immutable audit trail
nodes.rationale: Append-only log of every mutation with timestamp, actor, action, subject and details. The screen states entries cannot be edited or deleted. Gives a sovereign, auditable change history for CMDB and asset data.

nodes.label: Stale-after-days tenant setting
nodes.rationale: Tenant setting for how many days pass before a record is marked stale. Changed from 30 to 31 in the audit sample. Thresholds live in tenant settings, not in code.
